How to complete your paperwork

Time sheet guidance

General

  • Enter all your time and expenses at the end of every day. It keeps entries clean and saves time.
  • Time sheets must be submitted complete and accurate to Lola no later than Monday close of business.
  • Late or inaccurate time sheets may delay your expense reimbursement.
  • If you receive a request for corrections, update and return it immediately.
  • If you complete your time sheet over the weekend, log those hours so you get paid for them.
  • Attach your formal service report for the visit along with your time sheet so Paolo can file it.

Time sheet

  • Standard regular working hours: 8 hours per day.
  • Standard overtime: any hours worked over 8 hours per day.
  • Standard overtime limit: no more than 10 hours per day.
  • 12-hour days are approved only after Paolo verifies the need. If agreed, each tech is limited to 2 days of 12 hours per week.
  • Enter job numbers for every day. Leave unused lines empty.
Example. You travel 4 hours on Monday, then work at the customer from noon until 5 PM (end of business for technicians), and stay 2 more hours. That is 11 hours total: 4.00 weekday travel, 5.00 regular, 2.00 OT.

Expenses

  • List expenses in date order.
  • Costs for job numbers ending in S1 (or any S-number) are billable: Y.
  • Warranty job numbers ending in W1 (or any W-number) are billable: Y.
  • Costs without a job number (tools, clothing, computer supplies) are not billable: N.

Service report

  • Each job number gets its own service report.
  • You must enter the customer name, job number and commessa (machine) number.
  • You must enter the scope of visit, using the job description emailed to you each Friday for the following week.
  • Ask Paolo for guidance on service report entries.

Recipe sheet

  • Record all change-format data when setting up the format, and use Special notes for any modifications to the machine or change parts during installation.
  • Drop a picture of each HMI screen into the matching box. Use Misc pictures for machine condition or change-part modifications.

Working offline

  • Use the download arrow at the top right to save an offline copy. Open that file in Chrome, Edge or Safari on your laptop or tablet; it works with no internet.
  • The offline copy carries the report you had open when you saved it, and keeps your edits in that browser.
